create_single_peg_insertion_env: create a SinglePegInsertion environment with default config for ALOHA peg insertion task
create_default_config: create a default config dict with reward scales and simulation parameters for the peg insertion task
run_single_peg_insertion_reset: run the reset method of SinglePegInsertion to initialize the simulation with random peg and socket positions
run_single_peg_insertion_step: run the step method of SinglePegInsertion to advance the simulation and compute rewards for peg insertion
review_single_peg_insertion_reward: review the _get_reward method of SinglePegInsertion that computes left, right, lift, orientation, and insertion rewards
